name: bank_team_router
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific kind of request is it? Pick the option that best matches what the customer needs.

criteria.activate_card: How to activate a newly received card, or whether it needs activating
criteria.card_expiring: Card is about to expire or has expired; getting a replacement for expiry
criteria.card_acceptance: Where or at which merchants/ATMs the card can be used or is accepted
criteria.card_arrival: A card that was ordered has not arrived yet; tracking a card in the post
criteria.card_delivery_time: How long card delivery takes, or delivery options and dates for a new card
criteria.card_linking: Adding/linking a card to the app, including re-adding a card that was found again after being reported lost
criteria.card_not_working: The card has stopped working in general, with no specific merchant decline or ATM event described
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept/retained the customer's card and they want it back or need help
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual or disposable card is rejected or not working
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits on disposable virtual cards: how many, how many uses
criteria.get_virtual_card: Getting or accessing a virtual card, or virtual card not yet received
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical plastic card, or physical card cost/availability
criteria.spare_card: Getting an additional/spare/second card, e.g. for a family member, and its cost
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Any question about the two card networks Visa and Mastercard: which one the bank issues, choosing between them, getting both, or whether cards of those networks can be used with the service
criteria.card_limits: General spending or daily limits on the customer's own card
criteria.change_pin: Changing, setting, finding or receiving the card PIN
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked or rejected after wrong attempts; card locked by PIN
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgotten or not-working app passcode/login code; resetting app passcode; app not recognising the user's login
criteria.lost_stolen_phone: The customer's phone was lost or stolen, or they left it somewhere
criteria.lost_stolen_card: The customer's card was lost or stolen and they want to report it, block it, know what to do about the loss, or object to charges or fees because the card was stolen (not just asking the price of a replacement card)
criteria.compromised_card: Suspicion that the card or account details were compromised or used by someone else; wanting to freeze the card
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A charge or payment on the account that the customer does not recognise or says they did not make (unknown charge, unknown merchant)
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal the customer did not make
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise or wants to dispute
criteria.unknown_money_in_account: Money appeared in the account that the customer did not put there
criteria.request_refund: Asking for a refund for a purchase, or how merchant refunds work, or cancelling a purchase
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund the customer expects has not appeared
criteria.charged_twice: The same transaction was charged twice / duplicated
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: The cash machine dispensed a different amount than the customer requested (less, more, or none of the money they withdrew), or the customer says they never received the cash from a withdrawal
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was cancelled/reverted/returned and the customer asks why
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wanting to cancel or reverse a transfer the customer made, including transfers sent to the wrong account
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment at a shop or online was declined
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The customer's card or withdrawal request was refused at a cash machine, so the withdrawal could not be made
criteria.pending_card_payment: A payment the customer made (a card purchase, or a payment of unspecified kind) is still pending / not yet completed and they ask why, what it means or how long
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal still shows as pending or not shown
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is pending and the customer asks why or how long
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive, generally or from a region; also a general question about how long a transaction takes to complete when no specific pending purchase is described
criteria.transfer_not_received: The recipient has not received a transfer the customer sent
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed and the customer asks why
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot send money to a particular beneficiary/recipient or exchange
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account from another bank account
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money, salary or payments from other people or an employer into the account, including asking whether one can be paid in another currency
criteria.balance_not_updated_transfer: Balance not updated after an incoming bank transfer
criteria.payment_status_general: Missing payment or money not visible in balance, no more detail
criteria.top_up_by_card: The steps to top up the account using a debit/credit card (not whether a given kind of card is accepted)
criteria.top_up_cash_cheque: Topping up by cash or cheque deposit, where to deposit
criteria.top_up_bank_transfer: Topping up the account by bank transfer (how to)
criteria.balance_not_updated_deposit: Balance not updated after depositing cash or a cheque
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or was declined (not involving Apple Pay or Google Pay)
criteria.top_up_pending: A top-up is pending or its status is unknown
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted, returned or cancelled, or the topped-up money disappeared
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on how much can be topped up
criteria.apple_google_pay: Anything about topping up or paying with Apple Pay or Google Pay, including a top-up through them that fails or which currencies or cards work with those top-ups
criteria.verify_top_up: Why a top-up needs verifying, or where to find the top-up verification code
criteria.top_up_general: General questions about how to top up / add money and where to find the option (not which kinds of card are accepted for it)
criteria.card_payment_fee: A fee was charged on a payment, purchase or transaction the customer made (paying by card, a purchase from another country or in another currency, a completed transaction), or whether card payments cost money
criteria.cash_withdrawal_fee: A fee was charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM
criteria.transfer_fee: A fee was charged for a transfer, whether transfers or receiving money cost money, or whether incoming money arrives in full without deductions
criteria.top_up_fee: Fees for topping up by card or by bank transfer
criteria.exchange_rate: How exchange rates are set or what rate applies
criteria.exchange_in_app: How to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.wrong_fx_card_payment: The exchange rate applied to a card purchase or payment looks wrong or different from what the customer expected
criteria.wrong_fx_cash_withdrawal: The exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal abroad was wrong
criteria.extra_charge_statement: A small extra amount or extra fee that the customer notices on the statement or in the app and asks to have explained or says is an error, where they do not link it to any transaction or action they made; includes such charges that are still pending and ones they say they bought nothing for
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies the bank supports for holding balances and exchanging
criteria.supported_cards_currencies: Whether the bank accepts a particular kind of card for adding money (credit cards, cards from another country, other card networks) or which cards and currencies can be used to top up the account itself (not to send money to others)
criteria.physical_card_cost: How much a new or replacement card costs, including a replacement after the customer lost their card
criteria.verify_identity: How to verify identity, which documents are needed
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank serves or where the account can be used
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details such as name, address, phone number
criteria.transfer_methods: How to send money to someone, or what can be used to fund an outgoing transfer (for example whether a credit card can be used to send money)
